task: Uploading a file through the files= argument breaks when the file object is a wrapper/proxy that forwards attribute access with __getattr__ (it exposes read() only dynamically). Building the multipart body fails with a TypeError instead of reading the wrapped file, for example when posting a NamedTemporaryFile-style wrapper. Such wrappers should upload exactly like real file objects.
setup: uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest pytest-httpbin pytest-mock trustme pytest-timeout
